subtasks.description: Create WebSocket server with authentication and task subscription management

verification.instructions: Connect to ws://localhost:3001/ws with x-api-key header (or ?api_key= query param), verify connection accepted

subtasks.notes: Created apps/frontend/src/main/api/websocket.ts with WebSocket server implementation. Features: API key authentication via x-api-key header or api_key query param (using authenticateWebSocket middleware), task and project subscription management, event type filtering, ping/pong for connection health, graceful cleanup on disconnect. Exports: registerWebSocketRoute() to add /ws endpoint to Fastify, broadcast functions (broadcastTaskProgress, broadcastTaskStatusChange, broadcastTaskLog, broadcastTaskError, broadcastTaskExecutionProgress), client management (getClientCount, getAllClients, closeAllConnections). Also added @types/ws dev dependency for TypeScript support. TypeScript verification passed. Commits: 41a665c (websocket.ts), ea40c69 (@types/ws).

description: This feature adds an HTTP API layer to AutoClaude, exposing existing IPC (Inter-Process Communication) functionality through REST endpoints and WebSocket connections. The API enables remote control of AutoClaude's task management, project operations, and real-time monitoring capabilities, with the primary use case being a mobile companion app. The implementation includes OpenAPI/Swagger documentation auto-generated from TypeScript interfaces and API key authentication for secure remote access.
